entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter! It's inaccurate, I don't like the fit, and I just want my money back. Your website says I have 10 days, so just process the return.

I understand your frustration. I just need to advise you that for our wearable monitors, the return **policy** can be different due to **hygiene** reasons. Once the seal is broken and it's worn, **sanitation** becomes a major concern. Looking at your purchase date, it was delivered 37 days ago, so I'm afraid it might be **too late**.

WHAT?! Are you kidding me? Too late? That is absolutely unacceptable! I want to speak to a manager right now! This is bait and switch. I'm going to blast your company on every review site on the internet!
Sir, I understand you're upset. Please allow me just one moment to double-check our official knowledge base. I want to be 100% certain I'm not mistaken. Can you hold for just a moment?
Fine. But you have one minute before I hang up and call my credit card company.

Thank you for waiting... Okay, I've pulled up the official documentation here. And... you know what, I sincerely apologize. You are absolutely correct. I was mistaken. Our system confirms that your item is eligible for return within 10 days. You are unfortunately outside that period.
Oh. So you're saying you can process the return for a full refund then?

Yes, absolutely. My apologies for the confusion. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you right now and I've just sent it to the email address on file. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund once it's processed in our warehouse.
Okay. Well... good. That's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome, and again, my apologies for the error. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
